title: Tiny, cute bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#4a90d9' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='3' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#4a90d9' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='68' r='3' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <!-- Frame tubes -->
  <line x1='28' y1='68' x2='46' y2='40' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='68' x2='46' y2='40' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='40' x2='46' y2='60' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='68' x2='46' y2='60' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='60' x2='72' y2='68' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Seat post and seat -->
  <line x1='46' y1='40' x2='42' y2='30' stroke='#f7c948' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='28' rx='8' ry='3.5' fill='#8e44ad'/>
  <!-- Handlebar post and bars -->
  <line x1='72' y1='68' x2='65' y2='32' stroke='#f7c948' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='30' x2='72' y2='30' stroke='#f7c948' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#8e44ad'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#8e44ad'/>
  <!-- Crank and pedals -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='60' r='4' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='60' x2='40' y2='66' stroke='#2ecc71' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='36' y='64' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='60' x2='52' y2='54' stroke='#2ecc71' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='49' y='51' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <!-- Wheel spokes -->
  <g stroke='#7ec8e3' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <line x1='28' y1='52' x2='28' y2='84'/>
    <line x1='12' y1='68' x2='44' y2='68'/>
    <line x1='16.7' y1='56.7' x2='39.3' y2='79.3'/>
    <line x1='39.3' y1='56.7' x2='16.7' y2='79.3'/>
  </g>
  <g stroke='#7ec8e3' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <line x1='72' y1='52' x2='72' y2='84'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='68' x2='88' y2='68'/>
    <line x1='60.7' y1='56.7' x2='83.3' y2='79.3'/>
    <line x1='83.3' y1='56.7' x2='60.7' y2='79.3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Cute face on frame -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M42 54 Q46 57 50 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
